components.name: Wizard
components.description: Multi-step form in a dialog. On phones it opens as a bottom sheet. Each step can block Continue with `canProceed`, and `onBeforeNext` can run async work (save, validate) before the wizard moves on.

props.name: description
props.description: Screen reader text for the dialog.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Button that opens the wizard. Pass null to open it only from `open`.

props.name: headerAccessory
props.description: Sits beside the title, like an info icon.

props.name: onBeforeNext
props.description: Runs before each advance. Return false to stay put.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Runs when Continue is pressed on the last step.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Next button text. Pass an array for one label per step, e.g. ["Pick hours", "Review", "Save"]. An entry for the last step replaces `completeLabel`; missing entries fall back to the defaults.

props.name: divided
props.description: Lines between the header, progress, body and footer. Off for a cleaner panel.

props.name: compact
props.description: Smaller strip for six or more steps.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Desktop width. Pass a function to widen one step.

props.name: preventDismiss
props.description: Blocks Escape, outside click and the close button on the given steps.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets the desktop panel be dragged by its header.

examples.title: Wizard · dots · no lines
examples.code:
<Wizard
  title="Welcome"
  trigger="Dots"
  steps={SIMPLE_STEPS}
  indicator="dots"
  divided={false}
  maxWidth="sm"
  nextLabel={["Next", "Next", "Done"]}
/>
